name: Paria River Ranch
description: Bring your horses and/or mules and enjoy the beautiful trails right out of the ranch. We offer 12x12 pipe corrals & larger corrals for 2 or 3 horses/mules. You provide everything (water buckets, hay nets/feeders, manure fork). No shavings, please. We have potable water for you and your horses and other furry family members. We will pick up manure outside of your corral once a day. Muck buckets provided. Hay available for purchase. Text for more info. *Stalls must be cleaned daily. All manure and hay must be removed upon departure. A $40 clean fee will be applied if pen has not been mucked prior to check out.

name: Camp McClellan Campground
description: Camp McClellan Horse Trails Campground provides 50 campsites with 30 AMP electric service with water, there are also 15 primitive campsites. These sites have rock-based surfaces, with a mixture of pull-through and back-in options. Bring your horse (boots or shoes recommended) and come enjoy over 900 acres of pristine forest with more than 30 miles of dry trails and roads that roam through the foothills of the Appalachian Mountains at Camp McClellan Horse Trails in Anniston, Alabama. Breathtaking views can be enjoyed all year round! The area is rich in flora and fauna, and there are numerous species of birds and wildlife. Additionally, the campground features pine and hardwood forests, a diversity of plant life, and a few creeks. Horse accommodations can be reserved, and guests can utilize the 31-stall barn with 10×10 stalls or there are 15 corral panels that are 12×12 throughout the campground. Guests can also bring their own highline or there are some permanent highlines at specific campsites, see the site map below. Water is available at the barn and campsites.
